55902.fix: Upgrade Cisco IOS to version 17.3.8 or later
55902.commands:
show version
verify current version
download updated image from cisco.com
copy tftp flash
reload

78432.commands:
Download hotfix from Palo Alto support portal
Install via Device > Software
Reboot required

91345.fix: Disable vulnerable HTTP service and apply ACL to management interface
91345.commands:
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
ip access-list extended MGMT-ACCESS
permit tcp 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255 any eq 22
deny ip any any
